newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DepoTech rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DepoTech rated buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International said Tuesday it began coverage of DepoTech Corp with a buy rating.

-- "We find the shares of DepoTech to be attractive on a valuation basis," Vector said. "The keys to the stock's performance will be the completion of several near-term events, the most important being the (U.S. Food and Drug Administration's) approval of DepoCyt for the treatment of neoplastic meningitis arising from solid tumors. We have a high degree of confidence in the probability for the FDA approval of DepoCyt."
-- Vector said that DepoCyt is making its way through the FDA approval process, adding it expects the drug to be on the market in the third quarter of 1997.
-- Vector added that at 16-1/4, where it closed January 6, DepoTech's shares have increased in value by only 25 percent since late 1994, when the company public offering at $12 a share.
-- In the past year, Vector added, DepoTech shares reached a high of 29-1/2 in May. The slide in the stock price in the second half of 1996 mirrored a decline in the biotech sector.
-- Vector said it believes the depressed price of DepoTech's shares create a significant buying opportunity.
